summary: Build practical agricultural workplace safety systems that reduce incidents and protect workers. Enroll in this 5-day intermediate course.
lede: Safety in agricultural workplaces focuses on recognizing hazards and applying controls during farming and primary production. For operations managers, farm safety officers and production supervisors responsible for worker safety, training covers practical risk assessment, machinery lockout procedures, agrochemical handling, incident investigation and emergency planning.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is designed for professionals who hold direct responsibility for the safety and health of personnel within agricultural and primary production environments.
audience: Horticultural Site Managers focused on greenhouse safety
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of experience in agricultural operations or a supervisory role within a primary production environment. A basic understanding of workplace health and safety concepts is required. No prior experience with ISO 45001 is necessary, though familiarity with farm machinery and agrochemicals is highly recommended.
